title: Cebu shipping firm: Not under probe for alleged cigarette smuggling

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — Shipping company Gothong Southern has denied involvement in an investigation into the alleged illegal transport of foreign cigarettes, after reports linking shipping industry personalities to the multimillion-peso smuggling case. In a statement, the shipping company said it is not currently under investigation for the alleged violation of customs regulations involving the movement of foreign cigarettes. “In light of recent reports concerning the transportation of foreign cigarettes in alleged violation of customs regulations, Gothong Southern wishes to clarify that it is not currently the subject of any investigation in connection with this matter,” the company said.
